title: Salmon Quiche
subtitle: A dill and cream quiche with fresh and smoked salmon
excerpt: Flakes of salmon and wisps of smoked salmon in a cream custard scented with dill and lemon, baked in a golden shortcrust shell. Slices cleanly and serves well at any temperature.
sourceNotes: French quiche format adapted with salmon, a pairing common across northern European bistro cooking.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Bake the day before and refrigerate. Serve cold or warm briefly at 160C for 10 minutes.

content.text: This quiche combines gentle fresh salmon with the deeper savour of smoked salmon, bound in a dill-scented cream custard. It works equally well warm or cold. Do not overbake or the custard will turn rubbery and the salmon will dry out.
Roll the pastry to 3mm thick and line a 23cm loose-bottomed tart tin. Chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line the chilled case with baking paper and baking beans. Blind bake for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and paper and bake for 5 more minutes until the base is dry.
Whisk the eggs and cream together. Add the dill and lemon zest. Season lightly with salt and pepper, keeping in mind the smoked salmon is already salty.
Scatter the fresh salmon chunks over the base of the tart. Tuck in the pieces of smoked salmon between them.
Pour the cream mixture over the fish. It should reach just below the pastry rim.
Bake for 25 minutes until the custard is just set. The centre should still move very slightly when shaken.
Rest in the tin for 10 minutes. Unmould carefully and serve warm or at room temperature.

items.symptom: The salmon is dry and overcooked.
items.cause: The quiche baked too long or at too high a temperature.
items.fix: Pull the quiche as soon as the edges are set and the centre has just a slight wobble. Residual heat finishes the cooking.

items.cause: The smoked salmon was not taken into account when seasoning the custard.
items.fix: Season the cream mixture very lightly, or leave out the added salt entirely and taste after baking.

items.symptom: The pastry base is soft and pale.
items.cause: The blind bake was too brief.
items.fix: Return the empty case to the oven for an extra 3 to 5 minutes before adding the filling.
